resources.string: An unknown error has occurred. Please try again later.
No account found associated with this email address. Please check that the email is correct or sign up.
Your account has been disabled. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact support.
Your email address has not been verified. Please check your inbox and follow the verification link.
The email format is invalid. Please enter a valid email address.
This email address is already in use. If you already have an account, try signing in or resetting your password.
The password entered is incorrect or the email is not registered. Please check and try again.
The password is too weak. It must be at least 6 characters long.
For security reasons, you need to sign in again to complete this action.
A connection error has occurred. Please check your internet connection and try again.
You have attempted to sign in too many times in a short period. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
Two-step authentication is required. Complete the verification process to continue.
This authentication method is not enabled at the moment. Please contact the administrator.
The verification code is invalid or has expired. Request a new code and try again.
The email could not be sent. Please check your internet connection and try again.
Your browser does not support web storage, which may affect authentication. Try using a different browser.
